first_query_after_restart: one fresh process per program for the read matrix; only its first exact1 query receives this label; operating system cache is unknown
later_read_cases: same process and ordered cases; prior logical values or metadata can remain warm; each case has one unmeasured prime before steady samples
payload_recipe: SHA256 hex chunks from Layer2Final:number:revision:chunk truncated to body_bytes
seed_convergence: sync for a fresh home; original async for a reused baseline home
timed_convergence: normal default async; no sync background wait requested
